_note: Inspiration photos for the Who We Are page (owner, 26 Oct: replace the placeholder abstracts with 'cool aesthetic images about technology ... a unique design approach ... colour ... inspiration, not exactly the designs', from a free source, 4K). Free stock photos, NOT the studio's work: the panels say 'Inspiration' and credit the photographer, and none is ever captioned or linked as a project.

Source: Unsplash, free photos only (the Unsplash License: free for commercial use, no attribution required; never an Unsplash+ photo). Every original is 4K or larger (long side >= 4611 px) and is kept, untouched, in 'src'. No people, no brand marks.

scripts/prepare_supplied.py --table scripts/inspiration.json crops each original ('crop' = [left, top, right, bottom] source pixels; the panels to their tallest shape, 0.727), writes public/assets/inspiration/<name>-<w>.webp at the table's widths (an entry's own 'widths' wins) and records each image's 4 main colours ('palette'), which the panels show as a swatch strip. check.py: every entry prepared, shown on /who-we-are/ and credited.
slot: where who.py shows it. word: the panel's tag. focal: object-position of the cover crop.
